title: Application Engineer (m/f/d) - Ireland
description: **Company Description** **INFICON** is a leading provider of innovative measurement instruments, critical sensor technologies, and software solutions for smart manufacturing/Industry 4.0 that improve the productivity and quality of tools, processes, and entire factories. They are critical for equipment manufacturers and end users in the complex production of semiconductors and thin-film coatings for optics, flat-panel displays, solar cells, and industrial vacuum coating applications. Other users of our vacuum-based processes include the life sciences, research, aerospace, the packaging industry, heat treatment, laser cutting, and many other industrial processes. We also leverage our expertise in vacuum technology to offer unique products for the analysis of toxic chemicals in the fields of disaster response, security, and environmental health and safety. **Job Description** **Field Service & Technical Support** * Deploy, install, and configure FabGuard monitoring systems across multiple tool groups (Etch, CVD, PVD, Litho, etc.) * Provide on-site troubleshooting and technical support for FabGuard software, hardware, and data acquisition * Diagnose and resolve Windows system issues; perform PC installation, configuration, and cabling * Create recipes and data analyses using FabGuard for Fault Detection and Classification (FDC) * Deliver customer training on INFICON products; identify improvement opportunities and new application areas * Provide written and oral feedback on applications, process optimization, and installations **Data Acquisition & Systems Integration** * Configure and maintain data acquisition parameters between FabGuard and connected systems * Support integration projects involving industrial protocols (OPC-UA, SECS/GEM, TCP/IP, etc.) * Test and validate software updates; troubleshoot connectivity issues and data discrepancies **Stakeholder & Site Coordination** * Serve as on-site point of contact for our customers' teams across multiple fabs * Coordinate with out customer' teams (process engineering, equipment groups) on equipment readiness and logistics * Report site status and escalate risks to INFICON EMEA and US management **Reporting & Process Improvement** * Contribute to regular site status updates; identify and propose process improvements **Knowledge Transfer & Training** * Train our customers and contractor teams on FabGuard procedures; document site-specific configurations * Provide cross-coverage support to other field colleagues as needed **Qualifications** * Technical diploma or degree in electronics, automation, industrial systems, or equivalent professional experience * Solid working knowledge of Windows operating systems, including installation, configuration, and troubleshooting * Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes and OEM equipment, including lithography, PVD, and CVD technologies * Basic knowledge of vacuum pump and abatement system operation * Demonstrated ability to test and validate software in industrial and manufacturing environments * Comfort working in cleanroom environments and compliance with all cleanroom procedures * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with ability to engage directly with customer stakeholders * Prior experience in semiconductor fabrication environments is preferred * Familiarity with industrial protocols (OPC-UA, SECS/GEM, Modbus TCP) is a plus * Fluent in English, both written and spoken; additional languages are an asset **Additional Information** **INFICON** offers a dynamic work environment that promotes diversity, equality, and inclusion. Our respectful, innovative, and vibrant corporate culture is evident in everything we do and how we do it. **What can you expect from us?** * Smart and friendly colleagues who value team spirit, a positive attitude, and reliability - and who always make sure there’s plenty of fun to be had * Opportunities to share bold ideas and contribute creatively * Flexible work hours * Competitive salary, excellent benefits, plus profit sharing * Opportunities for continuing education and professional development * Celebrating successes together and dealing openly with failures - they’re invaluable for our continuous growth * Regular employee events **Take your next career step with us!** Would you like to learn more about us and find out what it’s like to be part of the INFICON family? title: Apprenticeship - Toolmaking
description: **Role Purpose:** The tooling apprentice will support the everyday functions of the toolmakers within the Tooling Departments in a high-volume injection moulding manufacturing setting. the tooling apprentice will engage in the toolmaker apprenticeship - Generation Apprenticeship **Key Responsibilities** The tooling apprentice will: * Compile standard specifications/procedures/records for each mould and monitor all existing moulds to standard specifications * Assist the toolmakers whilst they fit and assemble parts to make, repair, or modify dies, jigs, gauges, and tools, using machine tools and hand tools * Support the toolmakers with tool builds * Support initial tool trials and validations * Support tool changes where required * Carry out essential cleaning on parts, slides, tools * Support all aspects of machine and equipment maintenance, installation and modification * Document all work carried out, including upgrades/repairs on existing equipment/tools * Maintain the highest standards of hygiene and housekeeping * Ensure highest Quality Compliance standards, participating and complying with the Quality Management System * Identify and generate opportunities for improvement and actively participate in the implementation of corrective action plans and continuous improvement initiatives * Comply with all company policies and procedures, including quality requirements, financial controls, health and safety regulations, etc. *The above list of duties and responsibilities is not exhaustive, and the role holder may be required to carry out other duties which may reasonably be assigned by management* . **The Ideal Candidate** It is essential that the tooling apprentice has a keen interest in the tooling department. A good knowledge of injection moulding and how tooling is important in the process, an understanding of how to trouble shoot and experience with repairs and maintenance would be an advantage. Possessing excellent interpersonal, teamwork, IT and communication skills, it is essential that the tooling apprentice works effectively with others to achieve challenging objectives. The tooling apprentice will be a self-starter, organized, result-oriented with a strong work ethic and the ability and resilience to work under pressure.

title: Associate - Tax

The firm has a considerable global presence with ten offices (Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Dubai, Hong Kong, Guernsey, Ireland, Jersey, London and Singapore), 120 partners and 1000+ staff providing a 24/7 service to its clients who are at the cutting edge of capital markets, aviation finance, investment funds and cross-border finance. We believe our people are our competitive advantage. To be the leading international financial services law firm in the market, we aim to recruit, empower, develop and retain the best people in the market and provide opportunities for success. Walkers Ireland has consistently been one of Ireland fastest growing law firms. We currently have in excess of 190 employees in our Dublin office, and we are continuing to grow at a rapid pace. At Walkers, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can feel comfortable, happy and confident to be themselves. We believe that a diverse and inclusive business is more collaborative and innovative and provides great opportunity for our staff which in turn, allows us to better serve the needs of our clients. Additionally, we actively encourage participation in internal committees such as Corporate & Social Responsibility and Diversity and Inclusion along with other firm wide initiatives. Walkers is an equal opportunities employer. Walkers global is an equal opportunity employer. Equality and diversity are key to our global identity and an integral part of our goal to continue being an employer of choice. title: Junior Engineer - Commercial Project - Dublin City Centre
description: **Your new company** A highly successful and well-established main contractor is seeking a Junior Engineer to join their growing project delivery team on a landmark commercial development in Dublin City Centre. With a strong reputation for delivering high-quality projects across commercial, residential, healthcare, education, industrial and fit-out sectors, this contractor has built a track record of excellence, innovation and client satisfaction throughout Ireland. The company is renowned for its commitment to quality, safety and employee development, providing an environment where ambitious construction professionals can build long-term and rewarding careers. The business continues to secure prestigious projects and offers excellent opportunities for progression into Site Engineering, Senior Engineering and Site Management roles. Information about the contractor's sector experience and project portfolio was identified from public company information. **Your new role** As a Junior Engineer, you will work closely with the Site Manager, Project Manager and Senior Engineering team to support the successful delivery of a large-scale commercial construction project in Dublin City Centre.Key responsibilities will include: * Assisting with setting out and site surveying activities. * Supporting senior engineers with the coordination of subcontractors and site operations. * Monitoring construction works to ensure compliance with design specifications and quality standards. * Maintaining accurate site records, reports and documentation. * Assisting in the preparation of method statements, risk assessments and inspection plans. * Conducting quality inspections and ensuring works are completed to the required standards. * Liaising with subcontractors, design teams and project stakeholders. * Supporting the implementation of health and safety procedures across the site. * Attending site meetings and contributing to project planning activities. * Helping to resolve technical and construction-related issues as they arise. This is an excellent opportunity for an engineer looking to gain exposure to the full project lifecycle while working alongside experienced construction professionals on a busy city-centre development. **What you'll need to succeed** To be considered for this role, you should possess: * A degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline. * Previous experience gained through placements, internships or employment with a main contractor or subcontractor. * Strong knowledge of construction methodologies and site operations. * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. * The ability to read and interpret technical drawings and specifications. * Strong organisational and problem-solving abilities. * A proactive attitude and willingness to learn from experienced professionals. * Competency with Microsoft Office and relevant engineering software. * A strong commitment to health and safety standards. * Full working rights in Ireland. The ideal candidate will be ambitious, eager to develop their technical capabilities and motivated to build a long-term career within the construction industry. **What you'll get in return** In return, you will receive: * A competitive salary of €45,000 - €50,000. * The opportunity to work on a high-profile commercial project in Dublin City Centre. * Ongoing mentorship from experienced construction professionals. * Clear career progression opportunities within a growing main contractor. * Exposure to large-scale construction projects and modern building techniques. * Continuous professional development and training opportunities. * A collaborative and supportive working environment. * Excellent long-term career prospects with a company that values employee development. * Pension and additional company benefits package. * The opportunity to be part of a business with a strong pipeline of future projects. **What you need to do now** If you're interested in this opportunity, click "Apply Now" to submit your application, or contact us directly for a confidential discussion about your next move within the construction industry.If this role isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position within construction and engineering, please get in touch for a confidential discussion about your career options. title: Kraft Heinz Trainee Program – Dublin (Ireland) 2027
description: **Program Start Date:** 1 September 2027 **Duration:** 12-month program **Contract:** Permanent contract from the beginning of the Trainee Program **Business Function:** Sales, Marketing, Category Development, Finance, Supply Chain, People & Performance **Important to note:** Candidates will be required to demonstrate the right to work in the country they are applying for. If you are interested in one of our other Trainee locations, please check out our website and apply directly to your preferred location. Please note different locations may have different Traineeship start dates. **About Us** Kraft Heinz is a global food company with a delicious heritage. With iconic and emerging food and beverage brands around the world, we deliver the best taste, fun and quality to every table we touch. A consumer obsession fuels our progress as we drive innovation across every part of our company. **The Kraft Heinz Trainee Program** This Program is designed to grow the future enterprise leaders. We are looking for high-performing, ambitious, and creative individuals who are ready to lead the future of food and beverages. Throughout the program, Trainees will hone their understanding of our business through commercial rotations, collaborate across the business to grow our iconic brands, and learn how to build their own legacy. **What’s on the Menu?** Your journey will start with a functional onboarding, giving you a hands-on induction into each of our different functions. This is followed by a field sales placement to get to know our products and consumers! During the program you will get to work on an individual business project where you will be challenged to apply your problem-solving skills. Proficiency in additional European languages is highly valued. * Candidates will be required to demonstrate the right to work in the country they are applying for. * Mobility Preferences – candidates will be based in the location they apply to for first year. From second year onward, we are looking for candidates who are open to relocation within Europe, especially those based in the EU. **Our Values** Our Trainees are expected to live out the Kraft Heinz values as cultural champions and future leaders at the organization. At Kraft Heinz, our values are: * We are consumer obsessed * We dare to do better every day * We champion great people * We demand diversity * We do the right thing * We own it **The Recruitment Process** Applications open 15th September 2026 Applications close 18th October 2026 **Step 1: Application & Pymetrics Games Assessment (Sept/Oct)** * If you pass the Application, you’ll receive a link to complete Pymetrics online games * These games assess a candidate's cognitive, social, and behavioral traits - there is no right or wrong answer, it’s about how you think and approach tasks **Step 2: Pymetrics Video Interview (Sept/Oct)** * A short, pre-recorded video interview to get to know you better * You’ll receive the link only if you pass Step 1 **Step 3: Trainee & Business Interview (Sept/Oct)** * Opportunity for us to learn more about yourself and motivations * Opportunity for you to ask any questions you may have! **Step 4: Assessment Day (Nov)** * Group Assessment & Leadership Interview * You will learn more about the business, our culture and the Trainee Program **Step 5: Panel Interview with Leaders (Nov)** * Meet company leaders for yourself to share further about your goals and aspirations **Compensation** For this position, the gross annual target base salary is: €47,000.00 This is based on a full-time contract. In addition, this position is eligible for a performance-based bonus up to: 20% This bonus is subject to the terms and conditions of the bonus scheme. Additional benefits supporting your physical, emotional and financial wellbeing are available, which vary based on geographical location. **Kraft Heinz is an Equal Opportunity Employer – Underrepresented Ethnic Minority Groups/Women/Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity and other protected classes.**

title: Legal Analyst
description: **About Us** At Fenergo, we’re not just building software - we’re transforming how the world’s leading financial institutions fight financial crime. Headquartered in Dublin and trusted by over 100 of the world’s top financial institutions, we’re on a mission to change the game. We’re more than a global leader in AI-powered client lifecycle management - we’re reimagining how financial institutions tackle compliance. From Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML) to rapidly evolving regulations, we turn complexity into clarity. Our FinCrime Operating System, powered by agentic AI and intelligent automation, helps financial institutions move faster, act smarter, and stay safer across 120+ countries. But we don’t stop there. At Fenergo, we believe in a world where financial institutions aren’t just compliant - they’re confident. Where technology doesn’t just meet regulations - it stays ahead of them. Our mission is to empower financial institutions to stop financial crime and create a safer world. Every product we build, every innovation we deliver, and every partnership we forge is shaped by that belief. We’re tackling some of the toughest challenges in financial technology. From speeding up onboarding to uncovering hidden risks, our work empowers banks to serve their customers with speed, integrity, and peace of mind. Join us, and be part of a team that’s building smart solutions, solving real problems, and shaping the future - together. **Who are you?** You are a high-achieving, recent Law graduate keen to launch a stellar career as a commercial lawyer. But, right now, your plans may be on hold because you are waiting to finish FE-1s or secure a traineeship. You wish there was a place where you could work now to put your degree to use and get real legal and business experience. **Why should you join us?** If that’s who you are, and you are hard-working, diligent, self-motivating and enjoy being part of an organisation with exciting revenue growth plans, we would like to speak to you. Fenergo is shaping the future of our industry, and you will be afforded an opportunity to significantly impact the revenue growth of a major target market for the company. **What you will do?** As a Fenergo Legal Analyst, you will be a member of our Legal Department reporting directly to our Head of Legal (Sales & Commercial). With training and oversight by our experienced team of lawyers, you will facilitate sales of Fenergo’s technology products to our customers. Many of whom are global financial institutions – names you will know! You will help review contracts, prepare for negotiations with our customers’ legal and procurement teams, and assist with advice to Fenergo’s business leaders. You will also have opportunities to learn how our business operates by liaising with Fenergo’s commercial, technical and financial teams. **Responsibilities:** * Assist in all aspects of commercial contract review. * Prepare for contract negotiations with customers by drafting responses to customer legal and commercial requests. * Review customer relationship documents and other information to help provide strategic advice to Fenergo business leaders. * Assist generally with the operations of the Fenergo Legal Department. **Requirements** **Key Expectations:** * High-achieving Law graduate. * Keen interest in commercial law. * Intellectually curious. * Dogged determination to learn. * Superior attention to detail. * Excellent writing skills. * Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues to achieve common goals. **Benefits** **What’s In It For You?** * Healthcare cover * Pension * Employee Assistance Programme * Opportunity to earn an annual company bonus * 23 days annual leave * 3 company closure days * Extensive training programs, classroom and online, through ‘Fenergo University’ * Other competitive company benefits, such as flexible working hours, work from home policy, sports and social committee and much more * Buddy system for all new starters * Opportunity to work on a cutting-edge Fintech Product, using the latest of tools and technologies. * Defined training and role tracking to allow you see and assess your own career development and progress. * Work From Home set-up allowance **Diversity, Equality, and Inclusivity** Fenergo is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace, where all employees are valued, respected, and can reach their full potential. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Our hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We believe that a diverse workforce enriches our company culture, fosters innovation, and contributes to our overall success. We strive to provide a fair and supportive environment for all employees, promoting equal opportunities for career development and advancement. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply for employment opportunities and join our team in contributing to a collaborative and inclusive work environment.

Forecasting and reporting * Support forecast and budget work, comparing on-the-books business against targets. * Build and improve reports and dashboards that the commercial team uses to make decisions. * Own one strategic project end to end and present the findings to the commercial leadership team. **Benefits:** * Additional annual leave per year of service * Paid Day Off on your Birthday * Paid Day Off for Charity Work * Free Eye Test Voucher * Cycle to Work Scheme

title: Security Engineer, New Grad
description: Who we are: About Stripe Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career. About the team Stripe offers an interesting middle ground between joining a small startup and going to work for a multinational company. We have systems and processes optimized for early-career professionals. You will be in an environment that prizes rigor, discipline, and reliability—from our products, from our ways of working, and from our colleagues. You will learn how the best teams put together extremely reliable systems, and you will be responsible for operating these systems, with adequate backup when things get tough. The Security organization is dedicated to building and maintaining a secure financial infrastructure platform. By joining this team, you will be on the front lines, engineering solutions that protect the sensitive data and systems underpinning a huge portion of the world's economy. You will contribute to core security functions like threat detection and rapid incident response, building and scaling the platforms that manage vulnerabilities, and proactively performing offensive security assessments to identify weaknesses before they can be exploited. This is a chance to apply software engineering principles and new technologies such as AI to solve complex, high-stakes security challenges, ultimately ensuring that Stripe's mission to increase the GDP of the internet is achieved securely. What you’ll do As a Security Engineer New Grad you will have the opportunity to work across various security disciplines and own projects from start to finish. Your work will focus on securing Stripe's complex environment by applying software engineering principles to security challenges. \* You will learn and apply the principles of secure-by-default design by working closely with product and infrastructure engineering teams. * You'll develop a foundational understanding of various security domains, such as threat detection, incident response, vulnerability management, or offensive security. * You'll learn to act as a security subject matter expert, tailoring answers to both engineers and non-engineers. * You'll contribute to the development of internal tools and automation to scale security efforts across Stripe. * You will participate in threat modeling discussions, learning to balance security requirements with product advancement and user experience. Responsibilities \* Work on cross-functional projects, directly collaborating with other engineers * Give meaningful feedback on code reviews and technical designs * Contribute to our overall security posture by continuously improving security processes, tooling, and defenses. * Develop a deep understanding of Stripe’s security primitives, frameworks, and invariants. * Provide actionable insights to help identify, prevent, detect, and respond to anomalous or potentially malicious activity. Who you are: We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. Minimum requirements \* Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Computer Science or related field (graduating by Summer 2026) * Some experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Java, Ruby, Python, JavaScript, Scala, and Go. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present * Experience from either previous internships or working collaboratively on multi-person coding projects (in a university or professional setting) * Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor and subject matter experts * Aptitude to think like an attacker and reason through different approaches to reducing security risk. Preferred qualifications \* Experience in code review practices, and an understanding of how to safely update production systems * Familiarity with navigating and managing work in large code bases * Prior experience or course work in cyber security, digital forensics, or incident response (e.g., through log analysis or capture-the-flag events). * Familiarity with foundational security concepts such as the OWASP Top 10 web application vulnerabilities. * Basic knowledge of SQL or experience analyzing medium to large data sets. * Exposure to cloud computing platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. * An adversarial mindset, understanding the goals, behaviors, and TTPs (tactics, techniques, and procedures) of threat actors. In-office expectations Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible. Pay and benefits The annual salary range for this role in the primary location is €64,000 - €96,000. This range may change if you are hired in another location. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings (“OTE”) range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and specific location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the primary location may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process. Specific benefits and details about what compensation is included in the salary range listed above will vary depending on the applicant’s location and can be discussed in more detail during the interview process. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; retirement plans; health benefits; and wellness stipends. We look forward to hearing from you. At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us. Apply now Please find our EU applicant personal information notice here.

Understanding of secure coding practices and application security fundamentals. Interest in distributed systems, cloud-native technologies, and highly scalable applications. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills. Professional Skills **You** Take ownership of assigned work and deliver high-quality solutions. Demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to learn new technologies and business domains. Communicate effectively with engineers, product managers, and stakeholders. Collaborate well within cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. Seek feedback and continuously improve your technical and professional skills. Contribute positively to team culture and engineering excellence initiatives. **Corporate Security Responsibility** All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: * Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; * Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; * Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and * Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description: **Winthrop Technologies** is a dedicated data centre delivery partner providing turnkey solutions to our clients, headquartered in Dublin and delivering throughout Europe. Winthrop has grown to become the leading and most trusted company in our sector and is the only dedicated Data Centre delivery partner in Europe. We are currently constructing multiple turnkey data centre projects in seven different European countries, equating to over 430MW of IT load in flight. Due to continuous growth, we are pleased to announce that we are currently seeking a **Treasury Assistant** to join our team in **Head Office, Ballymount, Dublin 22** . This candidate must be detail-oriented, energetic and an enthusiastic individual who will support the Treasury & Banking Lead to work on all aspects of cash, banking and debt of the business. The successful candidate's position will be expanded to cover areas of cash and debt function as the person develops into the role and embeds process management, automation and reporting capability within the day-to-day deliverables. You will have strong communication, IT and organisational skills, with the ability to work effectively as part of a dynamic team in a fast-paced construction environment. **Responsibilities:** **Preparation and processing of payments on banking payment platforms** * Payment input for manual payments and payment files. * Progression, approval of new payees and progressing payment approval as required. **Cash balance reporting and review** * Bank account balance update and scheduling details of payments and receipts going through the bank accounts. * Comprehensive reporting of cash balances on a periodic basis. * Run bank statements and resolve payment and transaction queries. **Cash forecasting:** * Work closely with accounting teams, payroll teams, AR and AP to ensure accurate cashflow forecasting on a periodic basis. * Report on actual versus forecast on a weekly and monthly basis. * Prepare and circulate rolling cash forecasts based on existing outstanding balances and forecast projected revenues and payments. **Treasury back office and middle office duties:** * Confirmation of Treasury deals with banks for Money Market deals (deposits and loans) and Foreign deposit etc). **Bank account set-up:** * Bank account maintenance (account opening, closing, bank mandate updates etc). * Support new bank account opening as required. * AML/KYC and other ancillary information requests from the banks and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements in line with established banking structures. **Ad hoc treasury projects** * Process Documentation and providing / updating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) for routine tasks. * Contribute and support the automation agenda with a view to optimising the automation of financial and operational reporting. **Requirements** **Successful Candidate** * 3rd level degree in Finance or Accounting or a similar degree. Recognised Treasury or Accounting professional certification is an advantage * Minimum 1 year's experience in a Treasury environment (Banking or Corporate) is an advantage. * Proficient use of Microsoft Suite including Excel, Word and Outlook. * Previous use of NetSuite ERP and AIB IBB banking system is an advantage but not required. * Strong financial understanding, with some proficiency in financial modelling / forecasting. * Strong attention to detail and accuracy. Demonstrable analytical skills. **Benefits** * Opportunity to work on some of Europe's most prestigious data centre projects * A collaborative and supportive work environment * Excellent opportunities for professional development and career progression * Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package * Newly refurbished, modern office facilities * Contemporary kitchen and dining area for employees * Complimentary fresh fruit, tea, coffee, and filtered water provided

title: V.I.E. Financial Accountant
company: Societe Generale Corporate and Investment Banking - SGCIB
description: **Responsibilities** Société Générale Securities Services (SGSS) is part of Global Banking & Investor Solutions (GBIS), a key pillar of Société Générale’s universal banking model. SGSS has been active in Ireland for 20 years and is a leading player in servicing Irish domiciled and offshore collective investment vehicles. We act locally as fund administrator and depositary for a wide range of international clients who manage schemes from UCITS to AIFs including private equity and real estate structures, hedge funds and special purpose vehicles. The Finance department is responsible for 2 entities in Dublin; SGSS Ireland Ltd and SG Dublin Branch and provides all accounting, banking, intercompany invoicing, internal and regulatory reporting, internal and external auditing and other ad hoc queries from management. Reporting to the Head of Finance, the Financial Accountant is responsible for, amongst other things; applying principles of accounting to prepare financial reports, analysing financial information and using appropriate accounting control procedures.. In a very dynamic and growing business the Financial Accountant will be responsible for: * Compile and analyse financial information to prepare entries to accounts, such as general ledger accounts and document business transactions. * Prepare monthly closing pack to include monthly financial statements, reconciliation files and variance analysis and commentary. * Communicate financial reporting information both internally to head office and externally to the central bank before respective deadlines. * Monitor intercompany invoicing and aged debtors. * Process timely VAT information. * Prepare and file tax computation. * Analyze and review budgets, revenue and expenditure trends, and ensure expenditure control. * Resolve accounting discrepancies. * Recommend, develop and maintain financial data bases, computer software systems and manual filing systems (Dynamics, Management Reporter, Magnitude) * Interact with internal and external auditors in completing audits. * Other duties as assigned. * Participate in any finance related projects. * Provide accounting policy orientation for new processes. **A questionnaire will be provided to you in order to check your VIE (Société Générale and Business France) eligibility. For an efficient analysis of your application, please make sure to truthfully answer all the questions.** **Please note that it is mandatory to provide us a formal proof of your M2 diploma validation before the assignment start date. No VIE mission will start without this document. \*Grade sheets are not accepted as justification of diploma.** **Required** **Profile required** **PLEASE NOTE that since this program is primarily an international development program, candidates cannot apply to a VIE assignment in their own country of citizenship.** **To facilitate the examination of your application by our English-speaking managers, we thank you for applying in English.** Studies & experience: * Graduate with a Master degree from Business/Engineering School or University with a specialization in maths, business or finance Language skills: * A high level of fluency in the English language Technical, operational & Soft skills: * Excellent Excel skills * Excellent numeric and analytical skills with strong attention to detail * Good communication skills both oral and written * Ability to work as part of team or on own initiative to meet deadlines * Desire to learn new skills * Knowledge of finance, accounting, budgeting, and cost control principles including Financial Reporting Standards. * Ability to analyse financial and statistical data and prepare financial reports, statements and projections. * Knowledge of financial and accounting software applications. * Knowledge of statutory regulations. * Work requires willingness to work a flexible schedule in order to respect dead lines. The VIE assignment in a nutshell This VIE in Dublin is to begin as soon as possible, but you need to plan 3 months between your application date and the beginning of your VIE assignment. It will last 24 months. The VIE is a specific contract, under Business France’s eligibility criteria, opened to candidates under 28 and from the member states of the European Economic Space. For further information (including your financial indemnities), please see Mon VIE-VIA Business France. **Why join us** As soon as you arrive, you will be integrated into our teams and will learn every day alongside our experts, who will support you in your tasks. Gradually, you will become more independent in your projects, making this experience a real career accelerator. You will also discover all the diversity of our businesses, in a sector that is constantly evolving and innovating. At the end of your VIE, various opportunities could be offered to you, in Belgium and abroad. **Business insight** At Societe Generale, we are convinced that people are drivers of change, and that the world of tomorrow will be shaped by all their initiatives, from the smallest to the most ambitious. Whether you’re joining us for a period of months, years or your entire career, together we can have a positive impact on the future. Creating, daring, innovating and taking action are part of our DNA. If you too want to be directly involved, grow in a stimulating and caring environment, feel useful on a daily basis and develop or strengthen your expertise, you will feel right at home with us! Still hesitating? You should know that our employees can dedicate several days per year to solidarity actions during their working hours, including sponsoring people struggling with their orientation or professional integration, participating in the financial education of young apprentices, and sharing their skills with charities. There are many ways to get involved.
